- **The nightly file check reads each photo once (FL-1586):** File checks already reads every original to make sure it isn't damaged, so the nightly health scan no longer reads the same unchanged photos again. It still checks that they are there, and it still reads in full any photo that changed, so your drives do much less reading each night.
- **Collections and albums that hold albums (FL-1583, FL-1584):** a collection holding albums scrolls, and it can take its cover from one of the albums inside.
- **Lightroom and darktable edits come across exactly (FL-1569):** imported edit histories are replayed as they were made, not approximated.
- **Manager on Unraid (FL-1585):** Manager accepts an appdata folder on an Unraid exclusive share.
- **Desktop AI on Windows (FL-1581):** when the graphics-card check fails on Windows, it now says why.
